goal: Speed up balance calculations and coin selection for wallets with extensive transaction histories
Avoid iterating over permanently spent or conflicted outputs that are no longer usable
agreement: Strong support with verified 250x to 500x speedups on large wallets (remyers, w0xlt, Zeegaths)
Unaddressed objection: missing outputs after reorg and getbalances assert failures (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: database rewrites during failed load and uninitialized optional (jeanpablojp)
